items.title: Frank Tate interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001
items.q: I heard Nancy Wilson when she was maybe 21, right after she had done the two Capitol albums.

ctx.x: Well I guess it is at that. But I used to, when I was in high school, I was right outside Washington where the Howard Theatre is. And I used to tell my mother and father, “I’m going to the theater tonight.” They thought I was going to go see a Roy Rogers thing. I’d

probably go to hear Shorty Rogers or somebody. I heard Nancy Wilson when she was maybe 21, right after she had done the two Capitol albums. And she was eight feet tall and weighed a hundred and fifteen pounds and pure dynamite in a floor length blue dress. And the curtain opened and the audience went [gasp], and she slayed them. And I heard Redd Foxx, I heard Moms Mabley, I heard Quincy Jones’ big band, I heard Miles with, I think, Cannonball and Coltrane and I’m pretty sure Bill Evans but my memory of the…
[I’m sorry, we just lost your mic, Monk]
